# p4_commands.txt -- Perforce commands corresponding to this Chopper trim.
# Review each section, then run `p4 submit` yourself; Chopper does NOT submit.
# Paths are domain-relative; run these from the rebuilt domain root.
# `-t text+x` declares Perforce filetype `text` with the executable bit set.

# p4 edit -- PROC_TRIM files and GENERATED files that overwrite an existing depot file.
p4 edit -t text+x rtl2rtl.tcl
p4 edit -t text+x sta_setup.tcl

# p4 add -- GENERATED files newly created by this trim (no prior depot entry).
p4 add -t text+x eco_hook.stack
p4 add -t text+x header_domain.stack
p4 add -t text+x plain.tcl

# exclude_file_list -- files to remove from P4 client view.
# Paths are domain-relative ($ward not set; use as-is from domain root).
scripts/post_check.tcl
